28:     let cache_dir = PROJECT_DIRS.cache_dir();
29:     if let Some(metadata) = AssetsMetadata::load_from_folder(cache_dir)? {
30:         if !metadata.is_compatible_with(crate_version!()) {
31:             return Err(format!(

33:                  in '{}' are not compatible with this version of bat ({}). To solve this, \
34:                  either rebuild the cache (bat cache --build) or remove \
35:                  the custom syntaxes/themes (bat cache --clear).\n\

37:                  https://github.com/sharkdp/bat#adding-new-syntaxes--language-definitions",
38:                 cache_dir.to_string_lossy(),
39:                 crate_version!()
40:             )
41:             .into());
42:         }
43:     }
44: 
45:     let custom_assets = if use_custom_assets {
46:         HighlightingAssets::from_cache(cache_dir).ok()
47:     } else {
48:         None
49:     };
50:     Ok(custom_assets.unwrap_or_else(HighlightingAssets::from_binary))
51: }

54:     print!("Clearing {} ... ", description);

57:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
58:             println!("skipped (not present)");
59:         }
60:         Err(err) => {
61:             println!("could not remove the cache file {:?}: {}", &path, err);
62:         }
63:         Ok(_) => println!("okay"),
64:     }
65: }
